linux.version: Ramos 0.23.0 — compiler written in Ramos; Linux and Windows x64
linux.scope: Native CLI packaging; desktop and terminal interactions have separate native tests.

windows.version: Ramos 0.23.0 — compiler written in Ramos; Linux and Windows x64
windows.scope: Native CLI packaging; desktop and terminal interactions have separate native tests.

focused_cases: signed packet encoding, alias reset, exact 1024-command boundary
library and native raw-packet rejection preserving previous frame
actual native rectangle/disk interiors, box/line/circle strokes and single pixel
negative clipping, retained snapshot after source mutation and GC, resize reveal
frame replacement, empty white scene, 400 maximum-size snapshots and heap recovery
20 window lifecycles, native GDI object stability, close cleanup
interactive plot button, resize reflow and clean close on both native desktops
existing Notes text controls, dialogs, GC and process cleanup
scaling: GTK logical units verified with GDK_SCALE=1 and 2; Windows default DPI virtualization. Explicit per-monitor DPI is not implemented or claimed.
performance: No new general execution index or graphics speed claim. The 0.22 measurements remain historical.
remaining: broader libraries, benchmark categories and stable 1.0 compatibility review
